change_summary_ar: ربطت الوردية فعليًا بالحضور بمفتاح مركب (employee_id + work_date) بعد ما وسّعت آلية الربط العامة (_apply_join_specs) لتدعم مفتاح مركب (list) بجانب المفتاح المفرد القديم دون أي تغيير في سلوك الجوينز الحالية. ربطت الإجازة بمنطق مطابقة نطاق تاريخ جديد (match_date_range_source): هل work_date يقع بين تاريخ بداية ونهاية طلب إجازة معتمد وغير ملغى لنفس الموظف، مع اختيار حتمي عند تعدد المرشحين بدون تكرار أي صف حضور.
core_change_reason: See PROJECT.json core_change.reason (INT-02 section): additive composite-key support in _apply_join_specs, plus a new match_date_range_source function; existing single-field joins (employee join, base engine join_sources) are unaffected.
design_note_ar: اكتشفنا أثناء التنفيذ خطأ تصميم أولي: إضافة بادئة (prefix) لحقول أصلاً بادئة بنفس الاسم (roster_status + roster_ = roster_roster_status، leave_type + leave_ = leave_leave_type) كانت بتنتج أسماء أعمدة مكررة وغلط. الحل: أعدنا تسمية الحقل الداخلي لعقد الوردية من roster_status إلى status (فيبقى الاسم النهائي بعد البادئة roster_status كما هو متوقع)، وأزلنا بادئة عقد الإجازة بالكامل (الحقول leave_type وleave_request_id أصلاً واضحة بدون بادئة إضافية).
environment: Linux build workspace; Windows runtime not tested

acceptance_cases_covered.roster_shift_and_status_filled_on_match: PASS: an attendance row with a matching (employee_id, work_date) roster row gets roster_shift_id and roster_status filled correctly.
acceptance_cases_covered.no_roster_match_left_blank_not_rejected: PASS: an attendance row with no roster row for its own (employee_id, work_date) keeps roster_shift_id/roster_status blank and is still accepted.
acceptance_cases_covered.leave_overlap_visible_no_duplicate_rows: PASS: a leave request overlapping an attendance row's work_date surfaces leave_type/leave_request_id on that row; an employee with two leave requests (only one covering the work date) still produces exactly one attendance row, matched to the correct request.
acceptance_cases_covered.cancelled_and_pending_leave_excluded: PASS (beyond the minimum ask): a cancelled leave request and a Pending (not yet Approved) leave request covering the work date are both correctly excluded from linking.
acceptance_cases_covered.int01_and_foundation_tests_unaffected: PASS: TEST_HR_FOUNDATION.py, SMOKE_TEST.py and TEST_INT01_MULTI_SOURCE.py all pass unchanged.

limitations: No HTTP/dashboard.html upload flow for multiple files was built; the capability is tested directly against engine.process_file(..., auxiliary_paths=...).

Leave-overlap matching assumes at most one leave request should apply per attendance row; if two approved, non-cancelled requests for the same employee ever overlap the same work_date (a data-quality issue upstream), the one with the lexicographically largest leave_request_id wins deterministically, but this has not been validated against a real leave system's numbering.
Not tested on Windows or with a password-protected workbook for any of the four sources.
Whether real production data actually delivers leave in a file separate from attendance is still unconfirmed (see PROJECT_LOG.md).
